answer: Each new seat must archive a relic credential issued only after the operator locks a walnut bond equal to 100 times one epoch reward for 30 days, with no early withdrawal. Every epoch that relic signs a marble challenge: a sequential memory-hard puzzle calibrated so one honest solver spends about four dollars of hardware-time. Cloning N seats therefore needs N bonds held at risk plus linear hardware; any double-sign burns the entire walnut bond. A thousand fake identities would take a month, about four thousand dollars of compute, and one hundred thousand epoch-rewards locked and forfeitable.
